primary.title: ULIP or term plan plus mutual fund? One ₹2.5 lakh line decides the winner
primary.summary: Below ₹2.5 lakh a year, a tax-free ULIP beats an active fund. Above it, the ULIP trails an index fund by 12.7%. Here is the 20-year math. The post ULIP or term plan plus mutual fund? One ₹2.5 lakh line decides the winner appeared first on Blogs .
